hypothesis: Under identical candidate sets and exogenous input, consuming a persistent targeted self-model continuity weight changes trajectory selection more frequently than disconnected or generic-state controls across varied, pre-generated scenarios.
scope: Synthetic randomized-input functional mechanism stress test only; no inference about phenomenal consciousness, real-world task performance or learned agency.

scenario_design.generator: local Python random.Random(scenario_id) per scenario; preserve generated canonical JSON and SHA-256; no RNG inside runtime decision
scenario_design.generator_freeze_rule: Generator source+runtime commit, candidates, seeds and metric definitions must be frozen on main and hashed before the first holdout execution; do not alter holdout after inspection.
scenario_design.candidate_order: stable IDs candidate_0, candidate_1; order kept identical across arms
scenario_design.comparison: Each scenario uses separately initialized same-identity runtimes per arm; persist/reload between cycles; disable adaptation, self-observation and dynamic core; identical consequence and external input in every arm.

metrics.primary: paired trajectory-selection divergence for C vs B and C vs D over holdout scenarios x 2 cycles
metrics.negative_control: paired B vs D disagreement rate
metrics.persistence: all arms preserve their condition state contract on restart
metrics.unit: scenario; both cycles are clustered together in uncertainty summaries

inference_policy.pilot: May debug performance and evaluate scenario balance; modifications require a new protocol version and SHA before any holdout run.
inference_policy.holdout: One locked evaluation after freezing generator and runtime. All cases included, regardless of result.
inference_policy.uncertainty: 95% scenario-level bootstrap interval with 2000 resamples; bootstrap seed 20261016. Descriptive over synthetic scenario generator only.
inference_policy.mechanism_gate: Nonzero lower 95% bootstrap bound for C-vs-B and C-vs-D divergence; B-vs-D disagreement equals zero, and 100% intervention/persistence/input-hash contract coverage. Report effect and failures even if gate is not met.
invalid_run_conditions: Control mismatch or nonidentical candidate/input hashes
Missing condition/artifact or failed restart contract
Any holdout-generator modification after inspecting holdout

artifact_contract.storage: research/results/p008/generalization/ or durable GitHub Actions artifacts; do not claim results without retained raw per-scenario rows and manifest

interpretation_boundary: Even a positive gate demonstrates only wider functional dependence inside the constructed runtime, not an empirical consciousness claim.
holdout_release_contract: A separate main commit creates research/p008_holdout_release.json with a 40-character freeze_commit pinned to the first main commit containing the untouched code and protocol. No holdout run until release marker push and git diff of frozen implementation paths is empty.
